context:
Goal: a report's guard line names a real PR, commit, step or debt, so a habit is never taken for a guard (your Nov 8, 11:27 CST ruling).
Problem (rule): the new check refuses every guard line with no reference, even an honest "Guard: none needed, docs only" on a report that admits no mistake, so either reports drop such lines or the check grows exceptions.
Based on (read): decision mistake-means-missing-guard (a mistake means a guard is missing: the report names the PR, commit, step or debt that would have stopped it) and rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent (a guard that cries wolf is spent).
Departs from: main passes any guard line — the check refuses a guard line with no reference.
Nothing is wrong with a: it is the recommended pick. The lane first leaned to c; c is shown only because it widens the check, and is not recommended.
home: step habit-is-not-a-guard (a report's guard line names a real guard)

options.gain: No new allow list; the report changes to fit the check.
options.how: As built; a report with no guard to name leaves the line out, or names a step.
options.label: Refuse every guard line with no reference (Recommended)
options.lose: A report with no guard to name must omit the line.

options.how: The check reads a guard line only when the report admits a mistake.
options.label: Refuse only after an admitted mistake
options.lose: A habit line on a clean report passes.

options.how: "Guard: none", "n/a" and "not needed" pass; any other guard line with no reference is refused. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Allow the empty answers
options.lose: A word list the check accepts and someone keeps.

ref: lane habit-is-not-a-guard, draft PR #2881, Nov 12, 14:00 and 14:03 CST
reply: Closed 15:47 CST: you picked a. A guard line with no reference is refused; a report with no guard to name leaves the line out or names a step.
short: Guard line: always needs a ref
title: A guard line with no reference is refused; a report with nothing to name drops the line
why: The check's reach on clean reports is wider than your ruling said.
